```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-coordcube-overhead
#| fig-cap: "CoordCube overhead vs raw CoordPath"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

categories = ['raw CoordPath\nget 3x', 'CoordCube\naxis 3x', 'CoordCube\nfrom path']
values = [0.319, 0.319, 0.958]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.0, 3.5))
bars = ax.bar(categories, values, width=0.5, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')

ax.set_ylabel('Latency (ns)', fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.3)

for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.03,
            f'{val:.3f} ns', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

ax.annotate('Zero-cost\ninterpretation', xy=(0.5, 0.65), fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
